title: Future Travel Credit Vouchers Arising from a Vacation Package
content:
A future travel credit is issued for the value the cancelled package still carried after the penalty and the administration charge have been withheld, and carries an expiry set by the credit validity term of the product that produced it. This is the basis on which the desk deals with vouchers across the Vacation Package Products.

## Issuing a voucher

A future travel credit voucher is issued only when no voucher has already been issued against the same package. Whether one has already been issued is read from the ledger lines standing against that same package, correlated by the package's own reference, and a line issuing a future travel credit against it is what closes the question; the party's recollection of having received one is not the basis of this test.

A product whose credit validity term is zero issues no voucher at all, and the cancelled value is forfeited.

The voucher is issued in the name of the lead traveller and is transferable only where the producing product makes credits transferable.

## Applying a voucher

A voucher is applied only while the package record stands at quoted or deposit held. The state relied on is the one shown on the record of the package the voucher is being applied to, correlated by that package's own reference. A package standing at confirmed, travelling, completed, cancelled or closed admits no redemption.

A voucher is applied to the price of a new package before any discount and never to the deposit alone, and the balance is collected in the ordinary way.

## What a voucher is not

The value on a voucher is never paid out in money, and an unused voucher is never extended beyond its expiry.

| Question about a voucher | The answer this basis gives |
| --- | --- |
| May a second voucher be issued against the same cancelled package | no |
| May a voucher be issued on a product whose credit validity term is zero | no, and the cancelled value is forfeited |
| May a voucher be redeemed by someone other than the lead traveller | only where the producing product makes credits transferable |
| May a voucher be turned into money | no |
| May an unused voucher be extended past its expiry | no |
